# sleep statement

Pause the current DCode execution without parentheses.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `statement.sleep` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Statements |
| Family | Sugar |
| Monaco kind | `statement` |
| Format | `sleep <seconds>` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `sleep 1.0` |

## Transformation

sleep(<seconds>)

## Example

```lua
sleep 1.0
```
